unit.label: -ful
unit.mentor_note: Ful has two senses that are easy to confuse: full of a thing (beautiful) and apt to do a thing (forgetful). CAT vocabulary-in-context questions live in exactly that gap.

members.meaning: showing skill, often of a cunning kind

predict_options.text: Full of something, or apt to provide it

discovery.understand_note: Watch the two senses. Healthful does not mean healthy: it means health-giving. An author who writes healthful is making a claim about effect, not about state.

applies.prompt: Knowing -ful means full of, and remembering that a writer chooses it for tone, what does artful most often mean?

options.text: Skilful, often with a hint of cunning
